queries.name: protocol
queries.sql: SELECT current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only, current_setting('transaction_isolation') AS isolation, transaction_timestamp() AS assessed_at, current_setting('statement_timeout') AS statement_timeout

queries.name: tenants
queries.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT id, 'tenant_'||dense_rank() OVER(ORDER BY "createdAt",id) AS alias,status,"industryPresetId","calendarSource","createdAt" FROM "Tenant") SELECT t.alias,t.status,t."calendarSource", CASE WHEN lower(coalesce(t."industryPresetId",'')) IN ('barbershop','beauty','dental','auto_service') THEN lower(t."industryPresetId") ELSE 'unqualified_or_unspecified' END AS explicit_vertical, coalesce(c.provider,'none') AS provider, c.status AS integration_status,c."watchStartedAt",c."verifiedAt", t."createdAt" FROM t LEFT JOIN "CrmIntegration" c ON c."tenantId"=t.id ORDER BY t.alias

queries.name: core_counts
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "Client") clients,(SELECT count(*) FROM "Client" WHERE "mergedIntoClientId" IS NULL) unmerged_clients,(SELECT count(*) FROM "Client" WHERE "userId" IS NULL) clients_without_user,(SELECT count(*) FROM "CrmClientLink") crm_client_links,(SELECT count(*) FROM "Appointment") appointments,(SELECT count(*) FROM "MeasurementRevision") measurements,(SELECT count(*) FROM "DomainEvent") domain_events,(SELECT count(*) FROM "ReconciliationRun") reconciliation_runs,(SELECT count(*) FROM "InternalAvailabilityRule") internal_capacity_rules,(SELECT count(*) FROM "InternalAvailabilityException") internal_capacity_exceptions,(SELECT count(*) FROM "Expense") expenses,(SELECT count(*) FROM "ExpensePeriodDeclaration") expense_declarations,(SELECT count(*) FROM "RecoveryConversion") recovery_conversions,(SELECT count(*) FROM "TenantBusinessConfigurationRevision" WHERE namespace='c8_valuation') c8_policies, to_regclass('"C8ModelVersion"') IS NOT NULL c8_model_table_present

queries.name: appointments_by_tenant
queries.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT id,'tenant_'||dense_rank() OVER(ORDER BY "createdAt",id) alias FROM "Tenant") SELECT t.alias,coalesce(a."crmProvider",a.source) provider,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a."mayaClientId" IS NOT NULL AND c.id IS NOT NULL AND c."mergedIntoClientId" IS NULL) exact_current_client_rows,count(DISTINCT a."mayaClientId") clients,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a."mayaClientId" IS NULL) missing_client,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a."staffId" IS NULL) missing_staff,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a."branchId" IS NULL) missing_branch,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a.attendance IS NULL) unknown_attendance,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a."totalPriceKopecks" IS NULL) missing_booked_price,count(*) FILTER(WHERE a."updatedAt">a."createdAt") changed_since_first_stored,min(a."startAt") earliest_visit,max(a."startAt") latest_visit,min(a."createdAt") earliest_mirror_admission,max(a."updatedAt") latest_mirror_update FROM "Appointment" a JOIN t ON t.id=a."tenantId" LEFT JOIN "Client" c ON c.id=a."mayaClientId" AND c."tenantId"=a."tenantId" GROUP BY t.alias,coalesce(a."crmProvider",a.source) ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: appointment_outcome_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT coalesce(attendance,'UNKNOWN') attendance,status, CASE WHEN "endAt"<=transaction_timestamp() THEN 'past' ELSE 'future' END AS time_window,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "mayaClientId" IS NOT NULL) client_linked FROM "Appointment" GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 3,1,2

queries.name: temporal_appointment_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT to_char(date_trunc('month',"startAt"),'YYYY-MM') AS period_month,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "mayaClientId" IS NOT NULL) client_linked,count(*) FILTER(WHERE attendance='arrived') arrived,count(*) FILTER(WHERE attendance='no_show') no_show,count(*) FILTER(WHERE attendance IS NULL) unknown_attendance,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "createdAt"<"startAt") stored_before_start FROM "Appointment" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 120

queries.name: visit_subject_history
queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT "tenantId","mayaClientId",count(*) FILTER(WHERE attendance='arrived' AND "endAt"<=transaction_timestamp() AND status<>'cancelled') arrived,count(*) FILTER(WHERE attendance='no_show' AND "endAt"<=transaction_timestamp()) no_show FROM "Appointment" WHERE "mayaClientId" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT count(*) observed_subjects,count(*) FILTER(WHERE arrived>0) subjects_with_arrival,count(*) FILTER(WHERE arrived>1) subjects_with_multiple_observed_arrivals,count(*) FILTER(WHERE no_show>0) subjects_with_observed_no_show FROM h

queries.name: measurements
queries.sql: SELECT kind,state,coalesce(completeness,'NULL') completeness,coalesce(qualification,'NULL') qualification,count(*) rows,count(DISTINCT "clientId") exact_client_subjects,min("admittedAt") earliest_admission,max("admittedAt") latest_admission,min("periodFrom") earliest_source_period,max("periodTo") latest_source_period FROM "MeasurementRevision" GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

queries.name: events
queries.sql: SELECT type,source,"ingestionMethod",observation,status,count(*) rows,count(DISTINCT "entityId") entities,min("occurredAt") first_occurred,max("occurredAt") last_occurred,min("receivedAt") first_received,max("receivedAt") last_received,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "receivedAt">"occurredAt") received_later FROM "DomainEvent" GROUP BY 1,2,3,4,5 ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5 LIMIT 200

queries.name: event_payload_shape_only
queries.sql: SELECT type,k.key,count(*) rows FROM "DomainEvent" e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(e.payload) k(key) WHERE e.type IN ('appointment.created','appointment.attendance_changed','appointment.rescheduled') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2 LIMIT 100

queries.name: reconciliation
queries.sql: SELECT provider,coalesce(completeness,'unfinished_or_failed') completeness,count(*) runs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "failureCode" IS NOT NULL) with_failure,min("startedAt") first_started,max("finishedAt") last_finished,min("windowFrom") earliest_queried,max("windowTo") latest_queried,sum(fetched) fetched_observations,sum(created) created_observations,sum(updated) updated_observations FROM "ReconciliationRun" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: known_data_tables
queries.sql: SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND (table_name ILIKE '%payment%' OR table_name ILIKE '%refund%' OR table_name ILIKE '%salary%' OR table_name ILIKE '%cash%' OR table_name ILIKE '%forecast%' OR table_name ILIKE '%measurement%' OR table_name ILIKE '%evaluation%' OR table_name ILIKE '%capacity%') ORDER BY table_name

queries.name: safe_financial_source_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT currency,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "totalPriceKopecks" IS NOT NULL) booked_price_known,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "totalPriceKopecks" IS NULL) booked_price_unknown,min("startAt") first_source_at,max("startAt") last_source_at FROM "Appointment" GROUP BY currency ORDER BY currency

queries.name: expense_inventory
queries.sql: SELECT source,currency,count(*) rows,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "externalId" IS NOT NULL) durable_external_source_refs,count(*) FILTER(WHERE "actionExecutionId" IS NOT NULL) execution_refs,min("occurredAt") earliest_fact,max("occurredAt") latest_fact FROM "Expense" GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: pipeline_label_state
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) quarantined_deliveries,count(*) FILTER(WHERE resolution='open') unresolved_deliveries,min("receivedAt") earliest_received,max("receivedAt") latest_received FROM "IngestionQuarantine"

queries.name: linked_outcome_correction
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE a."mayaClientId" IS NOT NULL AND c.id IS NOT NULL) linked, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL AND a.attendance='arrived' AND a.status='completed' AND a."endAt"<=transaction_timestamp()) consistent_arrived, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL AND a.attendance='no_show' AND a.status='no_show' AND a."endAt"<=transaction_timestamp()) consistent_no_show, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.id IS NOT NULL AND a.attendance='arrived' AND a.status='canceled') conflicting_arrived_canceled FROM "Appointment" a LEFT JOIN "Client" c ON c.id=a."mayaClientId" AND c."tenantId"=a."tenantId" AND c."mergedIntoClientId" IS NULL

queries.name: linked_subject_history_corrected
queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT a."mayaClientId", count(*) FILTER (WHERE a.attendance='arrived' AND a.status='completed' AND a."endAt"<=transaction_timestamp()) arrivals FROM "Appointment" a JOIN "Client" c ON c.id=a."mayaClientId" AND c."tenantId"=a."tenantId" AND c."mergedIntoClientId" IS NULL GROUP BY a."mayaClientId") SELECT count(*) linked_subjects,count(*) FILTER (WHERE arrivals>0) subjects_with_arrival,count(*) FILTER (WHERE arrivals>1) subjects_with_multiple_arrivals FROM h

queries.name: other_durable_fact_snapshots
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "OwnerReportRun") owner_report_runs,(SELECT count(*) FROM "OwnerReportRun" WHERE "admittedAt" <= transaction_timestamp()) admitted_report_runs,(SELECT count(*) FROM "CashDeclaration") cash_declarations

caveat: Original visit_subject_history predicate used status != cancelled; canonical spelling is canceled. Corrected exact completed + joined Client results in followup, unchanged counts; followup is authority for subject totals. No raw rows exported.
